intro: From beyond death, Marg tells of the muckshell that killed Marg and of a duty still undone. Marg asks you to find that muckshell, recover the jeweled pendant stolen from Alliance soldiers and carry it to Nazeer Bloodpike in Brackenwall Village.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Cursed muckshell! You can't kill Marg! Ah, but I am dead. So it must have slain me...
But my mission! My mission! You, friend, must complete it.
While near Theramore, I spied a group of Alliance soldiers camped on the beach. And one soldier wore a pendant... A pendant laden with more gems than any soldier could afford!
That night I snuck into their camp and stole the pendant, but on my return to base a muckshell crab-man killed me!
Friend, you must find that muckshell and recover the pendant!

clips.title: Progress
paras: Friend, did you discover Marg's fate?

clips.title: Completion
paras: This pendant was worn by a soldier of Stormwind??
Thank you, friend. You have revealed the secret of Marg's death. But this pendant is a new mystery to solve, one that may have dire effects on the Alliance, and the Horde.
